descriptions.d24c_worm_pot_physics_800e58fc: Read the Worm.Bounce and Worm.Slide settings and the WormPot record. Return (releasing the record) if the pot's mode +76 or +80 is 1. Otherwise read the alternate bounce and slide settings; when the second argument is non-zero multiply slide by the pot's scale +24 and bounce by 1.0/scale; write both values back to the original settings; release the record.
